sloka: अद्य रामस्य रामत्वं पश्यन्तु मम संयुगे ।त्रयो लोकाः सगन्धर्वाः सदेवाः सर्षिचारणाः ।। ६.१०१.५६ ।।
transliteration: adya rāmasya rāmatvaṁ paśyantu mama saṁyuge ।trayo lokāḥ sagandharvāḥ sadevāḥ sarṣicāraṇāḥ ।। 6.101.56 ।।

translations.english: So saying, Rama with collected mind struck the ten-necked one in battle with sharp arrows adorned with burnished gold.
